value.rationale: The birth-time susceptibility asks which individual no-offspring event drives a global rooted-tree search-cost statistic. The exact harmonic conditional drop distinguishes young and old potential leaves, and the covariance contribution has a sharp nontrivial interior extremum at j/n=1/e; unmarked marginals or even their joint generating function cannot reveal this localization without age refinement. It is a natural complete per-birth-rank classification; not presented as a new discovery about the already-covered aggregate covariance.
